items.title: Prediction markets beat polls on speed but not always on accuracy, election experts say at NEXTPredict panel
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets beat polls on speed but not always on accuracy, election experts say at NEXTPredict panel** — At the NEXTPredict Summit in New York on Friday, Columbia University professor Rajiv Sethi, Decision Desk HQ analyst Geoffrey Skelley and PredictIt CEO John Phillips, in a panel moderated by Chuck Todd, said prediction markets react to developments faster than polls and models but can react quickly and wrongly, citing the final 2024 Des Moines Register poll in Iowa. Sethi and Phillips chose prediction markets as their single forecasting method for the final week before the midterms, Skelley chose forecasting models, and Phillips said some of PredictIt's most active traders conduct their own private exit polls. ([NextPredict](https://nextpredict.io/market-news/industry/markets-beat-polls-speed-not-always-accuracy/))

items.title: NEXTPredict forms strategic partnership with Hot Paper Lantern to promote its prediction markets summit, GlobeNewswire reports

items.title: Attorneys at NEXTPredict summit say state gaming laws should not apply to federally regulated event contracts as Supreme Court review looms, CDC Gaming reports
items.content_text: - **Attorneys at NEXTPredict summit say state gaming laws should not apply to federally regulated event contracts as Supreme Court review looms, CDC Gaming reports** — Panelists at the NEXTPredict Summit in New York on October 23, including Kalshi head of litigation Javalin Dedaj and Gemini Titan general counsel Brigitte Weyls, argued sports event contracts on federally regulated exchanges fall under the CFTC and should not be banned under state gaming laws. items.content_text: - **H2 Gambling Capital forecasts US NFL handle will dip 0.8 percent to 31.7 billion dollars as prediction markets take an estimated 2 billion dollars, GambleRss reports** — H2 Gambling Capital expects legal US handle on the 2026-27 NFL season to dip 0.8 percent year on year to 31.7 billion dollars, in part because prediction markets are now taking a meaningful share of legal-state betting activity. items.title: CFTC rules published October 19 split prediction market event contracts from sportsbook and casino gambling, Casino Journal reports
items.content_text: - **CFTC rules published October 19 split prediction market event contracts from sportsbook and casino gambling, Casino Journal reports** — Casino Journal reported the CFTC published two documents in the Federal Register on October 19 setting out where federal derivatives law ends and state gambling law begins. An interim final rule excluding casino-style gambling products from the swap definition took effect immediately, while a proposed rule would explicitly cover event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps, with comments on both due November 18. ([Casino Journal](https://www.casinojournal.com/news/cftc-swap-rules-prediction-markets-sportsbooks))

items.content_text: - **Kalshi and Polymarket pull back from China, India, Brazil and Nigeria as US financial classification draws foreign pushback, SCCG reports** — SCCG reported that Kalshi and Polymarket have retreated from China, India, Brazil and Nigeria after sanctions threats, because their CFTC financial-asset classification in the United States provides no cover against foreign laws that treat the same products as gambling. items.title: Crypto.com launches Predict Pro for US traders with order-book tools and combined positions, CryptoTimes reports
items.content_text: - **Crypto.com launches Predict Pro for US traders with order-book tools and combined positions, CryptoTimes reports** — Crypto.com launched Predict Pro on October 15 for US users, connecting them to OG.com Markets, a CFTC-registered exchange and clearinghouse, with real-time order-book data, probability charts and market, limit and stop orders. Traders can combine two to 20 predictions across sports, elections, crypto prices and Federal Reserve decisions into a single position. ([CryptoTimes](https://cryptotimes.fun/crypto-com-launches-predict-pro-for-us-prediction-market-traders/))
